notes: Plant wind case P09_hanging_vine (Hanging leafy vine) written by scripts/build_plants.py: Vine 16981 rebuilt from its segment subfiles as five links, hung by its end bar in a 60897 clip. Parts picked by constant name from data/categories/parts; frame LDU, -Y up, the case front faces -Z, ground (base top) at y = 0. The wind blows toward +X.

Joints: twist: real revolute about [0.0, -1.0, 0.0] through [20.0, -332.0, -30.0] (real: 16981 top end bar (16981k03) in the 60897 vertical clip; turns about the bar); bend_1: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [20.0, -252.0, -30.0] (flex_approx: 16981 is a flexible part (LDraw 'Flexible_Section' segments); the rebuilt rigid links bend at their joints. vine stem split at local x = -90); bend_2: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [20.0, -201.0, -30.0] (flex_approx: 16981 is a flexible part (LDraw 'Flexible_Section' segments); the rebuilt rigid links bend at their joints. vine stem split at local x = -141); bend_3: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [20.0, -150.0, -30.0] (flex_approx: 16981 is a flexible part (LDraw 'Flexible_Section' segments); the rebuilt rigid links bend at their joints. vine stem split at local x = -192); bend_4: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [20.0, -99.0, -30.0] (flex_approx: 16981 is a flexible part (LDraw 'Flexible_Section' segments); the rebuilt rigid links bend at their joints. vine stem split at local x = -243).
Real LEGO freedoms: twist. flex_approx joints (rigid tilt standing in for bending plastic, range <= 0.17 rad): bend_1, bend_2, bend_3, bend_4.

Sign convention by meaning (checked with the evaluator, kinematics.json): twist + = Top end bar in the clip (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z; bend_1 + = Vine bend 1 (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X) (lower part); bend_2 + = Vine bend 2 (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X) (lower part); bend_3 + = Vine bend 3 (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X) (lower part); bend_4 + = Vine bend 4 (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X) (lower part).

Motion comes from wind clips (scripts/wind_clips.py): a damped-response approximation, not aerodynamics. Ranges are catalog choices narrowed by sampled clearance (scripts/blender/check_plants_clearance.py), not measured stops. Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
